drop_reason: Although C0005 has coherent PBRM1/VHL mutation and RNA signaling evidence, it shows significant set-level technical associations with tissue source site (BP, OR 10.1, q=0.0034) and CT scanner model (LightSpeed16, OR 7.9, q=0.0034), providing a plausible competing technical explanation for its composition. This makes the candidate insufficiently defensible for retention.

observations.finding: 10/50 pathways significant at q<0.05; up-regulation of HALLMARK_UV_RESPONSE_DN (SMD 0.85, q=0.0084), HALLMARK_PANCREAS_BETA_CELLS (SMD 0.92, q=0.011), HALLMARK_TGF_BETA_SIGNALING (SMD 0.73, q=0.011), HALLMARK_HEDGEHOG_SIGNALING (SMD 0.82, q=0.024), HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE (SMD 0.76, q=0.024); MYC_TARGETS_V2 down (SMD -0.76, q=0.029).
PBRM1 enriched (79% vs 29%, OR 9.4, q=0.0024) and VHL enriched (84% vs 48%, OR 5.9, q=0.050). BAP1 absent (0% vs 15%, q=0.876).

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: RNA shows a coherent up-regulated signaling program with multiple FDR-significant pathways. WXS shows significant PBRM1 and VHL enrichment with large effects.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: C0005 is supported by concordant RNA signaling activation and strong PBRM1/VHL mutation enrichment, a coherent PBRM1-high pattern.
limitations: RNA and WXS coherence is descriptive.

observations.finding: Set-level significant associations: tissue_source_site:BP (84% vs 35%, OR 10.1, q=0.0034) and ct_scanner_model:LightSpeed16 (68% vs 21%, OR 7.9, q=0.0034). Nominal ct_manufacturer GE (95% vs 62%, q=0.063) and reconstruction kernel STANDARD (89% vs 55%, q=0.063).

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: C0005 shows significant technical associations with tissue source site and CT scanner model, indicating a plausible competing technical explanation for membership.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: Technical factors (source site, scanner model) are significantly associated with C0005 and could partially explain its composition; this weakens confidence that C0005 reflects a purely biological subtype.
limitations: Association does not prove causation; biological signal may coexist with technical structure.

observations.finding: Fused binary probe estimable with moderate resample stability (median ARI 0.73, consensus separation 0.73, PAC 0.40). Modality probe silhouettes: wxs 0.136, wsi 0.008, rna 0.003, ct 0.001. Patient membership support: median 2 modalities, no patient positive across all four. Boundaries to other sets estimable with positive fused separation.

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: C0005 shows moderate internal stability with WXS providing the largest modality separation; other modalities contribute weakly.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: C0005 has moderate internal coherence but is largely WXS-driven with limited cross-modal corroboration.

observations.finding: Adjusted Rand index 0.027, homogeneity 0.122, completeness 0.080 across 103 patients; stage distribution varies across sets (e.g., C0005 mostly stage I, C0001 more stage III/IV).
Adjusted Rand index -0.005, homogeneity 0.070, completeness 0.041 across 103 patients.

key_evidence.statistical_interpretation: Overlap with stage and grade is very low (ARI near zero), indicating the partition is not a recapitulation of these clinical labels.
key_evidence.medical_interpretation: The partition does not echo TCGA stage or grade; low overlap does not by itself establish molecular novelty.
limitations: Only TCGA stage and grade labels assessable.
Published molecular ccRCC taxonomies not evaluated.

actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA metabolic-suppression signature with multiple FDR-significant pathways, stable internal structure (ARI 0.79, PAC 0.29) with positive modality separation, and no set-level technical confounding. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0002 has coherent RNA metabolic-up regulation and a significant DST mutation enrichment, with no technical confounding. Internal resampling stability is weak (ARI 0.50, PAC 0.78), so structural confidence is limited, but no positive evidence supports split or merge; retained for downstream validation with this caveat.

C0003 shows concordant RNA immune/inflammatory activation and strong FDR-significant BAP1 enrichment, moderate internal stability with positive modality separation, and no significant technical confounding. Retained as a defensible discovery-stage candidate.

C0004 is defined by near-universal VHL mutation with low PBRM1/BAP1, a coherent mutation pattern, and no technical confounding. Structure is moderately stable but largely WXS-driven with low cross-modal membership support; no positive evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with this caveat.

Although C0005 has coherent PBRM1/VHL mutation and RNA signaling evidence, it shows significant set-level technical associations with tissue source site (BP, OR 10.1, q=0.0034) and CT scanner model (LightSpeed16, OR 7.9, q=0.0034), providing a plausible competing technical explanation for its composition. This makes the candidate insufficiently defensible for retention.

C0006 is defined by striking FDR-significant VHL and PBRM1 depletion with a directionally consistent RNA down-regulation pattern and no technical confounding. Structure is highly stable but almost entirely WXS-driven with negligible cross-modal corroboration; no positive evidence supports split or merge, so it is retained with this caveat.
